# Chloe

> Chloe is a free directory of kid-friendly activities and family-friendly
> venues across the United Arab Emirates (playgrounds, beaches, museums,
> indoor play areas, and more), filterable by child age, emirate, category,
> indoor/outdoor, and price.

## Key facts

- As of this writing, Chloe lists approximately 200 verified, active
  activities/venues (158 of them in the UAE, the rest in nearby GCC
  markets), with UAE coverage spanning all 7 Emirates: Dubai (56), Abu
  Dhabi (36), Sharjah (18), Ras Al Khaimah (14), Fujairah (13), Ajman (12),
  and Umm Al Quwain (9). This count changes as venues are added — see
  "Live data" below for the current number rather than relying on this
  static figure.
- Coverage: all 7 UAE Emirates — Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman,
  Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, Umm Al Quwain.
- Chloe is free for parents to use; venues can optionally partner for
  enhanced listings.
- Filters available: child age (0–12, with named sub-ranges from "Baby" to
  "Pre-teen"), emirate/region, activity category, indoor-only, free-entry
  only, and sort by rating / review count / name.
- Each listing includes: age range, indoor/outdoor flag, pricing, opening
  hours and days, address, amenities (e.g. parking, wheelchair access,
  nursing/changing facilities), and a star rating with review count.

## Live data

For the current, exact figures (not a stale snapshot), fetch:
- `https://chloe-app.com/api/stats` — total active venue count and average
  rating, computed live from the database.
- `https://chloe-app.com/api/stats/regions?countryCode=UAE` — live
  per-emirate activity counts.

## Key pages

- Home: https://chloe-app.com/
- Explore / search all activities: https://chloe-app.com/explore
- List your venue (for businesses): https://chloe-app.com/forbusiness
